ServiceRequest.name: ServiceRequest
ServiceRequest.description: Represents a formal request from a user for something to be provided, such as access, information, hardware, or software. This object manages the lifecycle of these tasks, which are typically low-risk, and can be fulfilled through a defined, repeatable process. For example, a Service Request can be created for an employee requesting a new laptop or a student needing a transcript.

AssignedGroupId.description: ID of the user group assigned to the service request.

AssignedUserId.description: ID of the user assigned to the service request.

BusinessHoursId.description: ID for the business hours used to determine the SLA calculation.

ClosedDate.description: The date when the service request was closed.

Description.description: A detailed description of the service request.

IsClosed.description: Indicates if the service request is closed (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsPaused.description: Indicates if the SLA timer is paused (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record

MilestoneStatus.description: Information about the milestone the service request reached.

Name.description: The name of the service request record.

OwnerId.description: ID of the user who created the record.

ParentServiceRequestId.description: ID of the parent request that this service request belongs to.

ReportedById.description: ID of the person who reported the service request.

ResolutionDate.description: The date and time when the service request was resolved.

ResolutionSummary.description: Resolution summary for the service request.

SlaEndDate.description: The date and time when the SLA timer ended.

SlaPauseDate.description: The date and time when the SLA timer was paused.

SlaStartDate.description: The date and time when the SLA timer started.

Status.description: Specifies the status of a service request.

StatusCode.description: The code that displays the status of the service request lifecycle.

Subject.description: A short description of the service request.
